summary: Short kerb beside townhouses near a junction; homes 14-17 m away.

best_section.where: North kerb of Rennie Street just east of the side-street junction

drivers.seclusion: Townhouse complex 14-17 m from the kerb, more homes across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street, cars park along this kerb; room for a van just past the junction.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street; corner is open to traffic from the side street.
drivers.convention: Cars park here, but no sign of overnight stays.

flags: Steep at the east end: max 16%
sun_shade: Open to sun; townhouse shades the kerb in the morning from the north.
